project_type: Python async memecoin scanner bot (signal-only, no auto-trading)
verification_instructions: 1. pip install -r requirements.txt 2. python -c 'from memescanner import main' 3. python -m pytest tests/ -v 4. python -m memescanner.main --help or dry-run check
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt && cp config.example.yaml config.yaml && edit config.yaml with Telegram credentials
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.9 available. httpx 0.28.1 pre-installed. aiosqlite and pyyaml need pip install.
contribution_requirements: Branch: feat/nas100-signal-bot. All code in memescanner/ package at repo root.
key_patterns: Async throughout (asyncio + httpx). SIGNAL-ONLY - never auto-trade. Self-adapting weights based on tracked outcomes. SQLite for persistence. Telegram for alerts.
directory_structure: Repo root: memescanner/ package with all source modules, config.example.yaml, requirements.txt, README.md, tests/ directory
